notes.title: More Balance Changes and Bugfixes
notes.content:
As we continue to try and find a good spot for difficulty, we are changing double notes to only deal 1 damage instead of 2 as well as reworking some of the zone 1 maps to ease the difficulty curve. Also a few quality of life changes.

Balance Changes
[list]
[*] Zone 1 maps reworked
[*] Double notes only deal 1 damage instead of 2
[/list]

Quality of Life Changes
[list]
[*] Mouse cursor disappears after being idle for 5 seconds
[*] Demo more closely reflects current version of full build (including all difficulties)
[/list]

Bug fixes
[list]
[*] More attempts to fix the save file bug (probably only affects players that played both demo and full builds)
[*] More attempts to fix tutorial bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[list]

[*] Some scenes not properly adhering to 16:9 fixed

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Difficulty Changes
notes.content:
In addition to bugfixes, we found that many players were struggling more than anticipated, so we are introducing an iframe after taking damage to make it a little easier to recover from a mistake. On Normal, we made it a bit easier to regen HP. Also, Demon fog tweaks.

Balance Changes:
[list]
[*] The player now is invulnerable for the next beat immediately after being hit.
[*] On Demon, player fog and lane fog are no longer ever active at the same time.
[*] On Normal, player regains HP every 5 notes in a combo instead of 10.
[*] Grading system has been adjusted and is basically the American school grading system.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed various leaderboard UI bugs
[*] Disabled pausing via alt-tabbing during scene transitions
[*] Progress not saving should be fixed (please make a discussion post if it is not)
[/list]
